text:
Type: round stainless steel wall clock
Use: telling the time at a glance on a wall; kitchen, home office, living room, hallway
Style: modern, industrial, minimalist
Materials: polished stainless steel rim, glass front, printed dial
Colors: silver steel, white face, black numerals and hands
Shape: classic round station-style face with large bold numbers, minute track around the edge, slim rounded rim, simple straight hands, clear and readable, medium size
Feel: practical, crisp, cool, orderly
Goes with: white or grey walls, chrome, black accents, concrete; modern, industrial or minimalist rooms
